subject.title: feat(ios): harvest shared chat capabilities — verbosity, trace toggle, live talk level, sessions entry

question: Should iOS intentionally share the `openclaw.webchat.showAssistantTrace` persisted preference and its default-on behavior with the existing web/macOS chat surfaces?
rationale: The code introduces a user-visible persisted preference through a cross-surface key; source-level correctness cannot establish the intended product scope of that shared setting.

options.title: Keep shared preference
options.body: Approve the existing key and default so iOS, macOS, and web chat use one trace-visibility preference contract.

options.title: Use iOS-local preference
options.body: Require a platform-specific storage key if trace visibility should remain independent on iOS.

recommendation.title: Keep shared preference
recommendation.body: Approve the existing key and default so iOS, macOS, and web chat use one trace-visibility preference contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged shared/native chat alignment work that established this preference convention.
